<subject>IBIT List for Fiscal Years 2022/2023</subject>
<body>
As Elaine and I will be attending the Telecom Industry Symposium tomorrow, we are sending you our comprehensive list of year-end IBIT items to review during your meeting.

For your reference, if there are more items than necessary, the ones I would suggest removing first are the Network Infrastructure fees, Regulatory compliance charges, and the allocation of specialized administrative overheads.

Please advise on how you would like to proceed.
</body>
